question: Which weeks met the treatment-plan goal?
answer:
**Only the week of 2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25 met the treatment-plan goal.**

The goal required “at least 3 therapy days and at least 150 minutes of patient-present therapy in each Monday–Sunday week.” [BH-D003] “Local treatment participation goal: at least 3 therapy days and at least 150 minutes of patient-present therapy in each Monday–Sunday week.”

| Monday–Sunday week | Therapy days | Patient-present therapy minutes | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11 | 3 | 140 | Not met |
| 2026-01-12 to 2026-01-18 | 2 | 120 | Not met |
| **2026-01-19 to 2026-01-25** | **3** | **180** | **Met** |
| 2026-01-26 to 2026-02-01 *(reviewed through 2026-01-30 only)* | 3 | 145–155 | Indeterminate |

For the met week, the included contacts were HG-E110, HG-E111, HG-E112, and HG-E113. The corrected attendance for HG-E110 states: [BH-D103] “Correction: Patient departure for HG-E110 is 11:15, replacing the original roster value of 11:30. Patient arrival remains 10:00.” The individual records support the other contacts: [BH-D105] “Patient contact: 11:15–11:45 | Completed: 30 minutes” and [BH-D106] “Total patient psychotherapy contact: 45 minutes.”

**Uncertainty:** The final reviewed week is not classifiable as met or not met because its documented minutes range, 145–155, straddles the 150-minute threshold. For contact HG-E115, one record says [BH-D111] “The full patient-contact interval for the encounter was 09:10–09:50.” while another says [BH-D110] “Actual patient psychotherapy contact: 09:00–09:50, 50 minutes.” The abstraction reports that a treating-clinician attestation or correction is needed to resolve this conflict. The January 27 group was excluded as a no-show: [BH-D108] “January 27 | HG-E116 | Skills group | 10:00–11:30 | — | — | No show; patient did not attend”.
